meta.name: CCNL per i lavoratori dipendenti dalle aziende di credito (ABI)

notes.text: Hourly divisor 162 for the 37.5h/week period (2023-11-23 to 2024-06-30) and 160 from 2024-07-01 (37h/week).
Seniority: first scatto after 48 months, then every 36 months; maximum 8 scatti for the Aree Professionali and 7 for QD3/QD4 (maximum_count_by_level).

Apprenticeship (Art. 35, rinnovo 23-11-2023) targets the 3ª area professionale without naming the level; modelled for destination levels 3A2, 3A3 and 3A4 with 18 months one level below, then the destination level. 3A1 is excluded because the level below (Area Unificata 1ª e 2ª area) is not an apprenticeship classification.

limitation.remediation: Confirm the destination levels of the Art. 35 apprenticeship against the contract text.

notes.text: INPS employer_rate 26.76% flat from kitech.it (Credito e Assicurazioni 2026); the Fondo di solidarietà del credito (bilateral) is presumed included in the aggregate rate. Verify against the annual INPS circular.

limitation.remediation: Verify the 26.76% employer rate and the solidarity fund share against the annual INPS circular.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (credito) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.

limitation.remediation: Source the credito rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/credito.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: IMPORTO EX RISTRUTTURAZIONE: the tables of the renewal print, next to the scatto, an 'importo ex ristrutturazione' (14,30 for QD3 and QD4, 7,99 for QD1, QD2 and the 3a Area, 5,59 for the Area Unificata); the bundle does not pay it. TERM: the renewal of 23 November 2023 expires on 31 March 2026 (Art. 1); the tables stay those of March 2026 until a renewal is read.

limitation.remediation: Source who receives the importo ex ristrutturazione and model it with the scatti, then remove this note.

notes.text: SCATTI FREEZE 2013-2014: no seniority for the scatti and the importo ex ristrutturazione accrues from 1 January 2013 to 31 July 2014 (Art. 103 c. 3, testo coordinato p. 142); staff in service on 19 December 1994 keep 12 scatti (Art. 94 c. 2, Art. 103 c. 2). The engine counts the seniority of the request without the freeze.

limitation.remediation: State the seniority of a worker in service in 2013-2014 net of the 19 months of the freeze.

location.quote: gli scatti di anzianità vengono riconosciuti con cadenza triennale [...] 4 anni per il primo scatto in tutti i casi di assunzione

provenance.transformation: Every 36 months, the first after 48; at most 8 for the 1st and 2nd level of the quadri and for the aree, 7 for the 3rd and 4th level of the quadri; the amounts are those of the tables of the renewal (Allegato 2).

location.section: C. Finanziamento, punto 1, lett. a
location.quote: a) contributo ordinario dello 0,20% (di cui lo 0,133% a carico del datore di lavoro e lo 0,067% a carico dei lavoratori) calcolato sulla retribuzione imponibile ai fini previdenziali di tutti i lavoratori dipendenti con contratto a tempo indeterminato, compresi i dirigenti

provenance.transformation: 0.133% employer and 0.067% worker of the INPS taxable pay of every permanent worker.
provenance.note: PDF sha256 17165601e0b65710bd79220f09f88b184c320b0347a2662dedb276a26ff951f0. Still in force in 2026: INPS bilancio preventivo 2026, cap. 31, p. 7 (https://servizi2.inps.it/servizi/ProvvedimentiFE/ProvvedimentiCDA/DownloadDocumentazioneAggiuntiva/326?nomefile=x.pdf, sha256 87277ac7102951e8ab702a24f08c30bec03c6e9538676c7b9156d37b5c787eb4): 'dal contributo ordinario (0,20 %) ripartito tra datore di lavoro e lavoratore nella misura rispettivamente, di due terzi (pari allo 0,133%) ed un terzo (pari allo 0,067%)'. Apprentices included: an apprenticeship is 'un contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato' (D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 41 c. 1, Normattiva, read on 2026-10-10); fixed-term workers excluded. Only the ordinary contribution is modelled: the additional contribution due when the fund pays a benefit and the straordinario contribution of the employers that use the assegno straordinario are not.

reviews.scope: P1 audit: stipendio of the nine levels in the four tranches, scatti, number of monthly payments and term, against the renewal of 23 November 2023.
findings: The 36 stipendi match the tables to the cent; they were cited to a union news page and are now verified against the tables of the renewal (pp. 35-38).
The first tranche runs from 1 July 2023 (the tables), not from the signing date 23 November 2023: corrected.
13 monthly payments: verified ('Importi mensili per 13 mensilità').
Scatti amounts match; cadence and maximum counts not in the tables: derived.
Importo ex ristrutturazione not modelled: declared. The agreement expired on 31 March 2026 (Art. 1).

reviews.scope: Registry check: CNEL code, name, signatories and term against the 21st CNEL report of CCNLs in force (30 June 2025) and the term clause of the text read in the P1 review.
findings: CNEL J241 matches (ABI with FABI, FIRST CISL, FISAC CGIL, UILCA, UNISIN; the report adds Intesa Sanpaolo as a depositor).

Term: Art. 1 of the renewal 'scadrà [...] il 31 marzo 2026'. The report shows 31/12/2028, which no text or party source supports; the parties suspended the deadlines to 31 July 2026 and the renewal is still open.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'straordinario, notturno, festivo, turni e maggiorazioni cumulabili': the overtime bands and the night, holiday and shift premiums of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: The overtime bands (25%, 55% night, 65% holiday) stay derived: the CCNL of 19 December 2019 that sets them is not published by a party in full, and the renewal of 23 November 2023 does not amend them. The hourly base of the ABI CCNL was not read: the BCC CCNL computes it on 90.66% of one twelfth of the annual pay, which the engine does not apply.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'scatti di anzianità, indennità e altri elementi fissi', re-read on the full text published by a party, found on 15 October 2026.
findings: Scatti: the 48-month first scatto, the 36-month cadence and the maxima (8; 7 for QD3 and QD4) match Art. 94 and 103: verified. The freeze of 1 January 2013 - 31 July 2014 (Art. 103 c. 3) is declared.
